title: Accurate Prediction of Sudden Cardiac Death Based on Heart Rate Variability Analysis Using Convolutional Neural Network.
summary: 1D CNN on HRV features from 115 PhysioNet subjects across NSR/CAD/CHF/VT/SCD groups; five-minute ECG segments. Reported very high accuracy, around 99.3%. Small subject set and segment-based model selection make performance potentially optimistic.
ai_technology: §2: CNN learns HRV group classification after ECG preprocessing and feature extraction; grid search tunes architecture and training parameters.
organization: Doctoral Program of Engineering Science, Faculty of Engineering, Universitas Sriwijaya, Palembang 30128, Indonesia
